ModMetaData.name: RimRound Rework WIP
ModMetaData.author: Niwatori401
ModMetaData.description:
Work-in-progress rework of RimRound for RimWorld 1.6.
Updated 25 October 2026: - Embodied Abundance, shared feasts, ceremonial feeding and designated ritual beds. - Assisted immobile guests, real meal collection, native ritual seating and return care. - Feeder +25% feeding speed, Feedee +20% eligible ordinary-food mass gain, Provisioner +25% source food production. - Working resting-bed gain bonus: +25% at Normal quality, capped at +50% at Legendary. - Kitchen workwear at both tailoring benches; quality-based smock, NovaTech and hoverchair bonuses. - Optional saved xenotype body-art override. This is a cosmetic override, not a race adapter or compatibility patch; custom body layers may remain visible and attachments may not align. - Food traders and dense imported meals. - Rejected-pawn reference cleanup and corrected distillery port overlay.
RimWorld 1.6 development build. New colonies and their later saves are the main target. Testing does not establish compatibility with every save or mod list, or performance in large colonies.
Updated 19 October 2026 (c24): - Fixed vanilla nutrient-paste reserve checks and exact hopper ingredient use. - Fixed liquid-food collection, outlet reservations and stock accounting. - Fixed prepared-food reconsideration during raw-food pickup. - Fixed optional shared-meal usefulness checks, including resumed jobs. - Fixed wasteful medical meals while nearly-full pawns recover from malnutrition. - Fixed retired VEF group references, cross-game weight history, book-author ownership and incompatible HAR tribal-chief biographies. - Fixed inventory food packing and kitchen-equipment research placement. - Fixed the reproduced RimRound sound-streaming errors with buffered loading.
Updated 17 October 2026: unified settings under Options > Mod options > RimRound; audited controls and display sizes; repaired social/assisted feeding and prepared-meal selection; correctly sized nude bodies when clothing art is missing.
Weight-related extra rest drain is reduced by 75% in an operating hoverchair and by 100% while stationary, immobile, carried or seated in a vehicle. Vanilla rest needs remain. Vehicle Framework and Vanilla Vehicles Expanded passenger feeding have been checked in the tested versions.
Obese and above receive natural/tended injury recovery at 110% of the ordinary rate after compensating for enlarged body-part health. Lardy and above resist new food poisoning. Both effects follow current eligible adult weight stage.
Male and female bodies, friendly and hostile pawns, prisoners and slaves are enabled by default at ages 18-1000. Existing custom switches and limits are preserved, apart from the one-time old 200-year upper-limit migration.
Anthrosonae is now fully supported. Base-mod adult appearances retain their coats, colours, head features and fitted tails/wings across supported RimRound body artwork and weight stages. Third-party addon content retains native fallback.
Includes the earlier food-density/digestion rework, complete Gain meals and food machinery.
